definitions.explanation: Animals raised on farms for food, labor, or other products, such as cattle, pigs, sheep, goats, and chickens.

examples.japanese: {家畜|かちく}を{飼育|しいく}する{農家|のうか}。
{家畜|かちく}の{伝染病|でんせんびょう}が{発生|はっせい}した。
examples.english: An infectious disease broke out among the livestock.

examples.japanese: {家畜|かちく}に{餌|えさ}をやる。

notes:
COMPOSITION: {家|か} (house, domestic) + {畜|ちく} (livestock, animal). Literally "domestic animals."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{家畜|かちく}を{飼|か}う/{飼育|しいく}する (to raise livestock)
・{家畜|かちく}{小屋|ごや} (livestock shed)
・{家畜|かちく}{伝染病|でんせんびょう} (livestock epidemic)
・{家畜|かちく}{市場|しじょう} (livestock market)
・{家畜|かちく}の{糞|ふん} (livestock manure)

COMMON LIVESTOCK:
・{牛|うし} (cattle)
・{豚|ぶた} (pig)
・{羊|ひつじ} (sheep)
・{鶏|にわとり} (chicken)
・{馬|うま} (horse)
・{山羊|やぎ} (goat)

RELATED TERMS:
・{畜産|ちくさん} (livestock farming)
・{飼育|しいく} (breeding, raising)
・{酪農|らくのう} (dairy farming)
・{野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ} (wild animals - contrast)
・ペット (pet - for companion animals)
